extracted.name: Hot and Sweet Ginger Drink
extracted.description: Try this sweet ginger tea as a substitute for hot spiced apple cider during the holidays or as a warm-you-up drink when the weather starts to get chilly.
instruction_lines: Bring water and ginger to a boil in a saucepan, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add brown sugar and honey and stir until sugar dissolves. Strain out ginger and serve.
